desc:
🗡️ Welcome to Sheriffs VS Murderers! 💥
Fast-paced combat with intense minigames.

How to Play
🗡️ Fight with knives and guns
💰 Earn coins by winning matches and eliminating players
🎁 Open mystery boxes to unlock powerful items
🔥 Build wins and climb the global leaderboards

Game Modes
⚔️ Team Deathmatch – Two teams. Fight the other team to win.
🦠 Infection – Infect all players to win.
🔥 Kill Confirmed  – Eliminate other players and collect their orb to win.

👍 Like the game and join the group for updates and rewards!

Jump in, master your skills, and prove you’re the best.
Good luck and have fun! 🎉
